reviews.comment: Profesor Olvera is an amazing professor. He is willing to take the extra step to help students. Visit his office hours for additional help.

Olvera is an amzing professor. He is very kind, silly, hilarious and always ready to help. His lectures are easy to comprehend if you are paying attention and he doesnt move on from a problem until everyone understands. He gets back to you pretty quick if you email him on canvas. He is very generous with grades if he sees you are trying hard. 10/10

Mr. Olvera is a great professor and always explains the material clearly, you will be fine as long as you pay attention in lectures, do all the homeworks & video quizzes, and study the week in reviews he provides a week before the exam. He is very silly but still very helpful during office hours.

Professor Olvera cares so much about his students. He makes sure you understand the material and usually helps us solve the hardest problems on the homework. He is very helpful during his office hours.

Uses notes and examples directly from the textbook/hw. Generally solves the hardest hw problem in class. 80% of your grade is based on exams, so you need to understand the material well. Helpful during office hours.

Good professor and can easily get back with him. The course is hard no matter the professor, mostly got help outside of class. Tons of HW, especially since I took this over the summer. Doing the practice problems over and over is the best way to prepare for each exam. Recommend going to tutoring or office hours to be successful in the class.

Took this class in the summer term and definitely did not regret it. As long as you do the Webassign's and understand the vast majority of the content, this class is very manageable. Professor Olvera was very accessible and offered extra credit oporutnties as well. Go to the Week-In Reviews and you will be beyond fine.

Professor Olvera really cares for his students. I took him over the summer online and I was really scared but you really shouldn't. He is open for any accommodation when you have a good reason. His class is not hard as long as you try. No textbook is need it. I would definitely take him again!

Professor Olvera was great. He gives every opportunity to pass the class and do well and is very understanding and will work with you if you have a conflict. He seems a little scattered in his own lectures sometimes, but he definitely cares about his work and students. I definitely recommend taking him if you get the chance!
